about: Skaters with 200+ minutes in 2025-26 who have played in 2026-27. Breakout: next season 900+ minutes (per 82 team games) and WAR a 1,000 minutes 1.0+ over his best to date: the highest WAR a 1,000 minutes, shrunk to replacement by ice time (k 600 minutes), of this season and the six before. Odds: logistic on shrunk WAR rate, gap to his best, ln minutes, D + age curve, low-TOI efficiency, projection gap, TOI room, TOI scaling, draft capital, site HPM, shot share, production; held-out log loss 0.2330 -> 0.2170 (t 8.8, 16/16 seasons). Tiers: next-season even-strength and power-play points a 60 at the minutes that ice time brings, fit on 8,426 season pairs; kept context: ev_p60 role; pp_p60 none; pp_toi role, frame, age, low-TOI rates. Tiers past the 99th percentile of rises seen (+5.1 min) are beyond the data. Goalies not included. NHL stats API, site WAR (MoneyPuck).
